module.summary: Typed bit-set wrapper that rejects undeclared storage bits.
module.long_description: Typed bit-set wrapper that rejects undeclared storage bits.
module.support_policy: Experimental modules remain available but may change through semantic contract versioning.

purpose.primary: Keep raw bit storage inside the set of enum-declared flag masks.

c_pain.summary: Raw masks and macros admit reserved bits and mix unrelated flag domains.
c_pain.why_c_is_attractive: Bit masks are compact and direct.
c_pain.where_c_degrades: Meaning and validity remain external conventions.

zig_response.summary: Derive an allowed mask from an enum and expose named operations.
guarantees_made_visible: constructed raw masks contain no unknown bits
remaining_programmer_responsibilities: validate semantic combinations beyond bit membership
